title: Register the property for livestock (PIC)
what: Register for a property identification code (PIC) for land where livestock are kept, and identify and record livestock movements under the NLIS.

sources.title: Property identification code
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will be required to have a Property Identification Code (PIC) if you graze livestock on your property or have a livestock business such as a sale yard, abattoir or stock agent.
